name: The Ethiopian Court Official
title: Ethiopia's Treasurer
summary: The Ethiopian court official was a high-ranking officer serving under Queen Candace of Ethiopia. He was on his way home from Jerusalem, where he had gone to worship, when he met the evangelist Philip, who explained the prophecy of Isaiah to him. He became the first known African convert to Christianity.

keyEvents.title: Journey from Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The official was returning to Ethiopia after worshipping in Jerusalem, showing that he was a God-fearing man seeking the God of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Reading the Prophet Isaiah
keyEvents.description: While sitting in his chariot, he read from the prophet Isaiah about the suffering servant but did not understand who the text referred to.

keyEvents.title: Meeting with Philip
keyEvents.description: The Spirit led Philip to the official's chariot, where he was able to explain that the passage from Isaiah was about Jesus Christ and his atoning death.

keyEvents.title: Baptism at the Water Source
keyEvents.description: When they came to a place with water, the official asked to be baptized. Philip baptized him, and he thus became the first known African Christian.

keyEvents.title: Continuing the journey with joy
keyEvents.description: After the baptism, Philip was taken away by the Lord's Spirit, but the official continued his journey with joy, now as a believer.
